title: Neural-only operating-point search for the tarsal-taste to MN9 route
status: PREREGISTERED. Committed before the search that scores it.
why_this_exists: demo02-feeding-v2 correctly refuses to run at an operating point selected for a visual descending-neuron route. This search asks only whether the full graph can carry tarsal taste input to the two MN9 rostrum-protractor neurons. It cannot inspect a body, a joint, or any F criterion.
grid_rationale: The registered 110 Hz taste transducer produced ten MN9 spikes in nine seconds at the unrelated visual operating point. The rate grid starts above that observation and spans sixfold; the synaptic and inhibitory ranges overlap the independently registered grooming and escape searches. All values are P/E calibration, not physiology.

entry.scripted_world_quantity: A declared sucrose concentration is placed on all four taste-bearing tarsi. Contact mechanics are intentionally absent because this is a neural-only search.

readout.scored_unit: raw spikes over each scored epoch

selection_rule: Among candidates passing N1 through N5, maximize the MN9 spike-count range across concentration. Ties choose the lowest taste_max_rate_hz, then the lowest synaptic_mv_per_contact, then the highest inhibitory_weight_gain.
this_search_may_not_see_the_behaviour_co: No code in this search imports, reads or scores demo02-feeding-v2 or F1 through F7. If no candidate passes, that negative is recorded and the embodied feeding contract stays unrun.
no_criterion_may_be_restated: The grid, epochs, criteria and selection rule are closed as of this commit.
claim_boundary: Engineering calibration only. Selection awards no tier and validates neither taste physiology nor feeding.
